QUOTE: Two near-misses are not render sites. `app/hooks/navigation_header.tsx` (`useAppNavigationHeader`) takes a `hasSearch` argument but renders the separate `Header` component. `app/routes/(authenticated)/thread.tsx` also renders `Header`, not `NavigationHeader`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly excludes the navigation hook and the thread route as renderers of NavigationHeader, noting they render the separate `Header` component.
